text:
heidi: heads-up — us-east-2 GPU warm-pool dip after this morning's egress ACL tighten. several nodes stuck NotReady during bootstrap :warning:
ops-bot: ALERT node-bootstrap-fail (us-east-2) 3255554319 — 10 nodes failing join
omar: quick look at kubelet on a failed node shows NAT port exhaustion + KMS handshake timeouts:
```
2026-06-12T14:02:10Z kubelet: outbound connect error: cannot assign requested address (no ephemeral ports)
2026-06-12T14:02:12Z keystore: KMS Decrypt timeout after 10s
```
heidi: ACL change added a deny for 100.64.0.0/10 on control-plane subnets earlier (rule 200). privatelink in this region uses a carrier range in that block so connections are being reset early.
omar: mitigation: 1) add narrow ACL allow for privatelink prefix 100.64.12.0/24 -> `aws ec2 replace-network-acl-entry --network-acl-id acl-0a1b2c --ingress --rule-number 210 --protocol tcp --port-range From=443,To=443 --cidr-block 100.64.12.0/24 --rule-action allow` 2) bump NAT port allocation on natgw pool and conntrack on edge routers 3) set cluster-autoscaler cooldown to 15m to avoid churn
security-bot: Temporary change CHG-PRIV-3255 created by omar; auto-revert in 30m unless security approves extension. Record justification and tag ticket.
cost-bot: initial cost impact estimate: +18% on on-demand GPU spend during 40m churn window. Please include in ticket.
heidi: filing INFRA-4502 with timeline, cmds, and cost numbers; will add runbook entry to include privatelink CIDR mapping in ACL templates.
ops-bot: ACL patch applied (patch-id acl-patch-3255554350). nodes joining: 3 -> 11 in 4m. autoscaler hold set for 15m. Monitoring for 30m. :white_check_mark:
